# Data contracts of the counterparty-risk pack

## AGR: Master agreement (`agreement`)

ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [agreement.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/agreement.contract.yaml) · version 1.1 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | legal-docs |
| Grain | One row per master agreement per business date, keyed by AGREEMENT_ID. |
| Key | `AGREEMENT_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^AGR-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Binding hint | lake table `legal.agreement`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/agreement |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGREEMENT_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA` (pattern `^AGR-`) |  |
| `TYPE` | text | required |  | The master agreement form, for example the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement. | `ISDA 2002 Master` |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY_NAME` | text | derived |  | The legal entity that signed the agreement with the bank. *the NAME of the agreement's COUNTERPARTY, looked up by Drishti; a master file does not carry it* | `Aldershot Pension Trust` |  |
| `GOVERNING_LAW` | text | required |  | The law the agreement is read under, which decides how close-out netting is enforced. | `English` |  |
| `SIGNED` | date | optional |  | The date the agreement was signed. | `2015-12-10` |  |
| `CLOSE_OUT_NETTING` | text | required |  | Whether a legal opinion confirms that on default the trades net to one amount; only then may exposure be netted. | `Enforceable` |  |
| `ELECTIONS` | record | optional |  | The master agreement's elections, one object: AUTOMATIC_EARLY_TERMINATION (boolean), CROSS_DEFAULT (the threshold as text), SET_OFF (boolean), TERMINATION_CURRENCY (ISO 4217), ADDITIONAL_TERMINATION_EVENTS and PROTOCOLS (text). |  | `election` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | The counterparty that signed the agreement: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |
| `CSAS` | id list | derived |  | The credit support annexes under this agreement, one per bank legal entity it covers (decision 9): CSA_IDs of the csa kind (CSA-<counterparty>-<legal entity>); empty when the agreement has none. *the reverse of the CSA's AGREEMENT link, derived by Drishti; a master file does not carry it* | `CSA-ALDERSHOT-FRA` | `csa` |

**Nested `ELECTIONS`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTOMATIC_EARLY_TERMINATION` | boolean | optional |  | Whether the trades end by themselves on certain defaults, without a notice. | `False` |  |
| `CROSS_DEFAULT` | text | optional |  | The threshold above which a default on other debt is a default under this agreement. | `3% of shareholders' equity` |  |
| `SET_OFF` | boolean | optional |  | Whether amounts owed under other contracts may be set off against the close-out amount. | `True` |  |
| `TERMINATION_CURRENCY` | text | optional |  | The currency the close-out amount is paid in. | `USD` |  |
| `ADDITIONAL_TERMINATION_EVENTS` | text | optional |  | Further events, such as a downgrade, that let a party end the trades. | `Rating downgrade below BBB-` |  |
| `PROTOCOLS` | text | optional |  | The ISDA protocols both parties adhered to, which amend the agreement. | `ISDA 2020 IBOR Fallbacks; 2018 US Resolution Stay` |  |

**Links:** `ELECTIONS` → `election`, `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `CSAS` → `csa`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `AGREEMENT_ID`, `TYPE`, `GOVERNING_LAW`, `CLOSE_OUT_NETTING`, `COUNTERPARTY`
- unique: key `AGREEMENT_ID`; per business_date
- pattern: field AGREEMENT_ID; pattern ^AGR-
- link: field ELECTIONS; kind election
- link: field COUNTERPARTY; kind counterparty
- link: field CSAS; kind csa

**Notes**

- Dated by the lake's business_date partition: `drishti.py lake build` writes each test-data file's day into it; the documents carry no date field of their own.

- required inferred from 100% coverage in 42 documents (18 samples and 24 test-data documents (data/testdata/counterparty-risk/agreement/agreement.2026-07-08.jsonl.gz, data/testdata/counterparty-risk/agreement/agreement.2026-09-30.jsonl.gz)): confirm each required field is mandatory upstream, and each optional one may be empty.

## CSA: Credit support annex (`csa`)

Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [csa.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/csa.contract.yaml) · version 1.1 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | legal-docs |
| Grain | One row per credit support annex per business date, keyed by CSA_ID. |
| Key | `CSA_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^CSA-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Binding hint | lake table `legal.csa`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/csa |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CSA_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `CSA-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^CSA-`) |  |
| `MARGIN_TYPE` | text | required |  | Variation margin (VM) covers today's value; initial margin (IM) covers how it may move before a default is closed out. | `VM` |  |
| `THRESHOLD_US` | amount | required | USD | The exposure the counterparty may have to the bank before the bank must post collateral. | `10000000.0` |  |
| `THRESHOLD_THEM` | amount | required | USD | The exposure the bank accepts before the counterparty must post collateral. | `10000000.0` |  |
| `MTA` | integer | required | USD | The smallest collateral movement either side may call. | `500000` |  |
| `INDEPENDENT_AMOUNT` | amount | required | USD | Collateral posted up front, whatever the exposure. | `0` |  |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | required |  | How often margin is called. | `Daily` |  |
| `CSA_CURRENCY` | text | required |  | The currency the CSA's amounts are in (thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, independent amount) and calls are made in. | `USD` |  |
| `MTA_US` | amount | required | CSA_CURRENCY | The minimum transfer amount when the bank delivers collateral. | `500000` |  |
| `MTA_THEM` | amount | required | CSA_CURRENCY | The minimum transfer amount when the counterparty delivers collateral. | `500000` |  |
| `MARGIN_FREQUENCY_DAYS` | integer | required | business days | How often a margin call may be made, in business days (1 for a daily CSA); FREQUENCY says it in words. | `1` |  |
| `MPOR_DAYS` | integer | required | business days | The margin period of risk, in business days, assumed between the last margin received and closing out a defaulted counterparty. | `10` |  |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | id | required |  | The bank legal entity the CSA is signed by (one CSA per agreement and legal entity, decision 9). | `LE-FRA` | `legal-entity` |
| `ELIGIBLE` | record list | optional |  | The collateral the CSA accepts, one element per asset class: ASSET (text) and its HAIRCUT (a fraction). |  |  |
| `AGREEMENT` | id | required |  | The master agreement the CSA belongs to: an AGREEMENT_ID of the agreement kind (AGR-…). | `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA` (pattern `^AGR-`) | `agreement` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | The counterparty of the CSA: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |
| `NETTING_SETS` | id list | derived |  | The netting sets margined under the CSA: NETTING_SET_IDs of the netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). *the reverse of the netting set's CSA link, derived by Drishti; a master file does not carry it* |  | `netting-set` |
| `COLLATERAL_BALANCES` | id list | derived |  | The collateral balances held or posted under the CSA, one per netting set: BALANCE_IDs of the collateral-balance kind (COLL-…). *the reverse of the collateral balance's CSA link, derived by Drishti; a master file does not carry it* |  | `collateral-balance` |

**Nested `ELIGIBLE[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ASSET` | text | required |  | An asset the counterparty may deliver as collateral. | `USD, EUR, GBP cash` |  |
| `HAIRCUT` | rate | required |  | The share taken off the asset's value when it is counted as collateral. | `0.0` |  |

**Links:** `AGREEMENT` → `agreement`, `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `NETTING_SETS` → `netting-set`, `COLLATERAL_BALANCES` → `collateral-balance`, `LEGAL_ENTITY` → `legal-entity`.

- required: fields `CSA_ID`, `MARGIN_TYPE`, `THRESHOLD_US`, `THRESHOLD_THEM`, `MTA`, `INDEPENDENT_AMOUNT`, `FREQUENCY`, `CSA_CURRENCY`, `MTA_US`, `MTA_THEM`, `MARGIN_FREQUENCY_DAYS`, `MPOR_DAYS`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `AGREEMENT`, `COUNTERPARTY`
- unique: key `CSA_ID`; per business_date

- link: field AGREEMENT; kind agreement

- link: field NETTING_SETS; kind netting-set
- link: field COLLATERAL_BALANCES; kind collateral-balance

**Notes**

- Dated by the lake's business_date partition: `drishti.py lake build` writes each test-data file's day into it; the documents carry no date field of their own.

## NSET: Netting set (`netting-set`)

Trades that net on close-out under one agreement and CSA, with exposure and collateral.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [netting-set.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/netting-set.contract.yaml) · version 1.1 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | xva-engine |
| Grain | One row per netting set per business date, keyed by NETTING_SET_ID. |
| Key | `NETTING_SET_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^NS-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Binding hint | lake table `credit.netting-set`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/netting-set |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NETTING_SET_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) |  |
| `TRADE_COUNT` | integer | derived |  | The number of trades that are netted together under the agreement. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the set's trade valuations; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `3` |  |
| `NET_MTM` | amount | derived | USD | The sum of the members' mark to market, positive and negative together. Netting lets a loss on one trade cancel a gain on another if the counterparty defaults. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the set's trade valuations; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `-339550` |  |
| `COLLATERAL` | amount | derived | USD | The net collateral against the netting set after haircut: what is held less what has been posted, each holding at its collateral value (market value less the CSA haircut; F3). Equal to the collateral balance's NET. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the set's collateral balance; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `-228402` |  |
| `LIMIT` | amount | derived | USD | The limit on the counterparty's peak potential future exposure approved for this netting set. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the counterparty's credit limit; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `5000000.0` |  |
| `CVA` | amount | derived | USD | The reduction in the value of the trades for the risk that the counterparty defaults before they mature. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the CVA engine's result; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `-7` |  |
| `TRADES` | record list | derived |  | The netting set's member trades, one element per trade with its status, product, asset class, currency, book, notional and MtM; empty when the set has no live trade on the date. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the set's trade valuations; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* |  |  |
| `BY_ASSET` | record list | derived |  | The set's MtM by asset class, one element per class present: ASSET and MTM in USD. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the set's trade valuations; a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* |  |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | The counterparty of the netting set: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |
| `AGREEMENT` | id | required |  | The master agreement whose close-out netting defines the set: an AGREEMENT_ID of the agreement kind (AGR-…). | `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA` (pattern `^AGR-`) | `agreement` |
| `CSA` | id | optional |  | The CSA margining the set: a CSA_ID of the csa kind (CSA-…), one per agreement and bank legal entity (decision 9); absent for an unmargined set. | `CSA-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^CSA-`) | `csa` |
| `CREDIT_LIMIT` | id | optional |  | The counterparty's credit limit: a LIMIT_ID of the credit-limit kind (LIM-…). | `LIM-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^LIM-`) | `credit-limit` |
| `CVA_RESULT` | id | optional |  | The set's valuation adjustments: a RESULT_ID of the cva kind (CVA-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | `CVA-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^CVA-`) | `cva` |
| `SACCR` | id | optional |  | The set's SA-CCR exposure calculation: a CALC_ID of the sa-ccr kind (SACCR-…). | `SACCR-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^SACCR-`) | `sa-ccr` |
| `SIMM` | id | optional |  | The counterparty's SIMM initial-margin calculation: a CALC_ID of the simm kind (SIMM-…). | `SIMM-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^SIMM-`) | `simm` |
| `COLLATERAL_BALANCE` | id | optional |  | The set's collateral balance: a BALANCE_ID of the collateral-balance kind (COLL-…). | `COLL-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^COLL-`) | `collateral-balance` |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | id | required |  | The bank's legal entity on the bank's side of the set: an ENTITY_ID of the core pack's legal-entity kind (LE-…). | `LE-FRA` (pattern `^LE-`) | `legal-entity` |
| `NETTING_ENFORCEABLE` | boolean | required |  | true when a legal opinion confirms close-out netting is enforceable for the set; false treats the trades gross. | `True` |  |
| `TRADE_IDS` | id list | optional |  | The member trades' ids, the same trades as TRADES[].TRADE_ID, as text (ENDUR digits, CLY-…, MX-…); empty when the set has no live trade on the date. |  | `trade` |

Regulatory EAD: replacement cost, PFE add-ons by asset class, multiplier.

|---|---|

| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALC_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `SACCR-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^SACCR-`) |  |
| `REPLACEMENT_COST` | amount | required | USD | The loss if the counterparty defaulted today and the trades were replaced at current market value, less collateral; never below zero. | `0` |  |
| `ADD_ON` | amount | required | USD | The potential increase in exposure over the next year, built from the add-ons of each asset class with supervisory factors and correlations. | `791562` |  |
| `MULTIPLIER` | rate | required | factor | A factor between 5% and 1 that reduces the add-on when the netting set is over-collateralised or its value is negative. | `0.933` |  |
| `EAD` | amount | required | USD | The SA-CCR exposure: 1.4 times the replacement cost plus the potential future exposure, where the potential future exposure is the multiplier times the add-on. | `1033938` |  |
| `RWA` | amount | required | USD | The exposure at default multiplied by the risk weight of the counterparty. Capital is a percentage of it. | `206788` |  |
| `ADD_ONS` | record list | required |  | The potential-future-exposure add-ons, one element per asset class present (Interest rate, Foreign exchange, Credit, Equity, Commodity): ASSET_CLASS and ADD_ON in USD. |  |  |
| `HEDGING_SETS` | record list | required |  | The hedging sets of the calculation, one element per asset class and hedging set (a currency for rates and FX): EFFECTIVE_NOTIONAL in USD and the supervisory factor SF (a fraction). |  |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | id | required |  | The netting set the calculation is for: a NETTING_SET_ID of the netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) | `netting-set` |

| `HELD` | amount | derived | USD | The collateral the bank has received from the counterparty, after haircut: the sum of its Held positions' VALUE (market value less the CSA haircut; F3). *a roll-up Drishti computes from the balance's POSITIONS (market value less haircut); a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `0` |  |
| `POSTED` | amount | derived | USD | The collateral the bank has delivered to the counterparty, after haircut: the sum of its Posted positions' VALUE (F3). *a roll-up Drishti computes from the balance's POSITIONS (market value less haircut); a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `228402` |  |
| `NET` | amount | derived | USD | HELD minus POSTED after haircuts: positive when the bank holds more collateral than it has posted, negative when it has posted more. *a roll-up Drishti computes from the balance's POSITIONS (market value less haircut); a master file does not carry it and an upstream value is ignored* | `-228402` |  |
| `AS_OF` | date | required |  | The date the balance is valued on: the business date of the file. | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `POSITIONS` | record list | required |  | The collateral assets behind the balance, one element per asset held or posted, with its market value, haircut and value after the haircut. |  |  |

| `NETTING_SET` | id | required |  | The netting set the collateral secures: a NETTING_SET_ID of the netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) | `netting-set` |

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |

| `DIRECTION` | text | required |  | Whether the bank posted the asset or received it. | `Posted`, `Received`, `Held` |  |
| `MARKET_VALUE` | amount | required | USD | The current market value of the asset before the haircut. | `76517` |  |
| `HAIRCUT` | rate | required | fraction of the market value (0.005 is 0.5%) | The share taken off the market value to allow for the price moving before the asset can be sold. The CSA sets it by asset type and maturity. | `0.005` |  |

## MC: Margin call (`margin-call`)

A variation or initial margin call and its settlement status.

|  |  |
|---|---|

| Status | active |
| Source | collateral-system |

| Key | `CALL_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^MC-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `MC-ALDERSHOT-FRA-1` (pattern `^MC-`) |  |
| `CALL_DATE` | date | required |  | The day the margin call was issued. | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `MARGIN_TYPE` | text | required |  | Variation margin settles the change in the value of the trades each day; initial margin is held against the risk of the value moving before a defaulted counterparty can be replaced. | `Variation`, `Initial` |  |
| `DIRECTION` | text | required |  | Who calls on whom. | `We call`, `They call` |  |
| `AMOUNT` | amount | required | CURRENCY | The amount called, positive, in CURRENCY; DIRECTION says who pays. | `18000.0` |  |
| `STATUS` | text | required |  | Where the call stands: Agreed (both sides agreed the amount) or Settled (the collateral moved); the call's EVENTS give the times. | `Agreed`, `Settled` |  |
| `DISPUTE_AMOUNT` | amount | required | call currency | The part of the call the other party does not accept. Undisputed margin is still due on time; the difference goes to dispute resolution. | `0` |  |
| `EVENTS` | record list | required |  | The call's history, one element per step in time order: AT (local date and time as text, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), EVENT (Call issued, Agreed, Settled) and BY (who acted). |  |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | id | required |  | The netting set the call is for: a NETTING_SET_ID of the netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) | `netting-set` |
| `CSA` | id | required |  | The CSA the call is made under: a CSA_ID of the csa kind (CSA-…). | `CSA-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^CSA-`) | `csa` |

| `EVENT` | text | required |  | The stage of the call, from issue to agreement and settlement. | `Agreed`, `Call issued`, `Settled` |  |
| `BY` | text | required |  | The party or system that took the step. | `collateral-system`, `counterparty ops`, `payments` |  |

## SIMMP: ISDA SIMM parameter files (`simm-parameters`)

The bank's licensed ISDA SIMM parameter files, one row a version, the file as delivered; the ccr engine reads them as a lake table (R2), never from a host folder.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [simm-parameters.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/simm-parameters.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | input |
| Status | active |
| Source | the bank's ISDA SIMM licence (the calibration ISDA publishes for each version) |
| Grain | One row per SIMM version, keyed by VERSION; a version is reference data, read on every date. |
| Key | `VERSION` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | on change (due: before the version's effective date (ISDA publishes a version about twice a year)) |
| Binding hint | lake table `collateral.simm-parameters`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/simm-parameters |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VERSION` | id | required |  | The SIMM version as the file names it (its version key). | `TOY-1` |  |
| `EFFECTIVE_FROM` | date | optional |  | The first date the version applies to, as the file states it. | `2026-01-01` |  |
| `TEXT` | text | required |  | The parameter file as delivered (YAML, the structure of docs/architecture/capital-parameters/simm.yaml); its SHA-256 is the provenance of every SIMM figure. |  |  |

**Validation**

- required: fields `VERSION`, `TEXT`
- unique: key `VERSION`; per business_date

**Notes**

- The test data holds the TOY file of the SIMM tests (round illustrative numbers, NOT ISDA's): it proves the formulas, never a margin. A bank loads its own licensed files.

**To review (1)**

- source: name the system that delivers the licensed files (the bank's ISDA SIMM licence) and who loads a new version.

## XRUN: Exposure simulation run (`simulation-run`)

An upstream exposure simulation of a business date: its paths, its grid of future dates (primary and look-back), its model and seed; the exposure engine reads it beside the paths (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 15.2).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [simulation-run.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/simulation-run.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | input |
| Status | active |
| Source | the upstream exposure simulator (test data: tools/packgen/ccr/make_ccr_data.py) |
| Grain | One row per simulation run and business date, keyed by RUN_ID; the newest complete run of a date answers. |
| Key | `RUN_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^XR-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]+$` |
| Dated by | `BUSINESS_DATE` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be agreed with the simulator's owner (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md open question 1); before its paths) |
| Binding hint | lake table `risk.simulation-run`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `RUN_ID`, `CALIBRATION`, `PATHS`, `STATUS`, `BATCH_ID` |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/simulation-run |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `XR-2026-09-30-01` (pattern `^XR-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]+$`) | `simulation-run` |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date | required |  | The close the run starts from (t0). | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `MARKET_DATA_DATE` | date | required |  | The market data the run calibrated to (normally the business date). | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `MODEL` | text | required |  | The scenario model, as free text. | `One correlated Brownian factor per asset class (rates, FX, …` |  |
| `MODEL_VERSION` | text | required |  | The simulator's version; with SEED, market data and trade versions the run is reproducible upstream. | `drishti-testgen-ccr-1.0` |  |
| `CALIBRATION` | text | required |  | REAL_WORLD (for PFE and limits) or RISK_NEUTRAL (for CVA and pricing) or STRESSED. | `REAL_WORLD` |  |
| `PATHS` | integer | required |  | The number of simulated market scenarios; every trade's values are on the same paths. | `200` |  |
| `SEED` | text | required |  | The random generator's seed of the run. | `ccr\|XR-2026-09-30-01` |  |
| `ANTITHETIC` | boolean | required |  | true when paths 2k and 2k+1 are antithetic pairs. | `False` |  |
| `GRID_DATES` | date list | required |  | The future dates the trades were valued at: the primary dates where exposure is reported and the look-back dates a margin period of risk before them. |  |  |
| `GRID_ROLE` | text list | required |  | One per grid date, in GRID_DATES order: PRIMARY (exposure is reported) or LOOKBACK (used only for collateral, the margin period of risk). |  |  |
| `LOOKBACK_OF` | vector | required |  | One per grid date: for a LOOKBACK point the index of the PRIMARY point it serves; -1 for a primary point. *24 values in the test data* |  |  |
| `GRID_TENORS` | text list | required |  | One per grid date: a primary date's tenor label (1W .. 10Y), null for a look-back date; absent, the engine labels by the nearest standard tenor. |  |  |
| `LOOKBACK_DAYS` | integer | required | business days | How many business days before each primary date its look-back date is: the margin period of risk the run assumes. | `10` |  |
| `VALUE_BASIS` | text | required |  | FUTURE (each MTM in USD of its grid date; Drishti discounts for CVA) or DISCOUNTED (in today's USD by the run's numeraire). | `FUTURE` |  |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required |  | The currency of every MTM vector: must be USD. | `USD` |  |
| `PRECISION` | text | required |  | float32 or float64: how the path values are stored. | `float64` |  |
| `CREDIT_PATHS` | boolean | required |  | true when the run also wrote credit-path rows (wrong-way risk). | `False` |  |
| `NETTING_SETS` | integer | required |  | How many netting sets the run simulated (a count, not an id), as an integer. | `8` | `netting-set` |
| `TRADES` | integer | required |  | The number of trades the run wrote paths for. | `523` |  |
| `ROWS` | integer | required |  | The number of exposure-path rows the run wrote; the run is complete when the lake holds that many. | `7540` |  |
| `BATCH_ID` | id | required |  | The run's batch id; every exposure-path row of the run carries the same. | `XB-2026-09-30-01` |  |
| `COMPUTED_AT` | timestamp | required |  | When the run finished, ISO-8601 UTC. | `2026-09-30T23:40:00Z` |  |
| `STATUS` | text | required |  | The run's status: complete is read; a run of any other status is not. | `complete` |  |

**Links:** `RUN_ID` → `simulation-run`, `NETTING_SETS` → `netting-set`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `RUN_ID`, `BUSINESS_DATE`, `MARKET_DATA_DATE`, `MODEL`, `MODEL_VERSION`, `CALIBRATION`, `PATHS`, `SEED`, `ANTITHETIC`, `GRID_DATES`, `GRID_ROLE`, `LOOKBACK_OF`, `GRID_TENORS`, `LOOKBACK_DAYS`, `VALUE_BASIS`, `CURRENCY`, `PRECISION`, `CREDIT_PATHS`, `NETTING_SETS`, `TRADES`, `ROWS`, `BATCH_ID`, `COMPUTED_AT`, `STATUS`
- unique: key `RUN_ID`; per BUSINESS_DATE
- pattern: field RUN_ID; pattern ^XR-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]+$
- link: field RUN_ID; kind simulation-run
- vector-length: field LOOKBACK_OF; same every row of one business date
- link: field NETTING_SETS; kind netting-set

**Notes**

- An upstream exposure simulation's record (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 15.2): the grid, the paths, the model; one per run and business date. Drishti reads it; nothing in it is computed by Drishti.

**To review (3)**

- required inferred from 100% coverage in 2 documents (1 samples and 1 test-data documents (data/testdata/counterparty-risk/simulation-run/simulation-run.2026-09-30.jsonl.gz)): confirm each required field is mandatory upstream, and each optional one may be empty.
- source is the pack's first listed source (its README): confirm.
- due time of each business date is not known: state it (for example, by 06:00 New York the next business day).

<a id="example-counterparty-risk-simulation-run"></a>

A real record, the most complete of the first rows (the one with the most non-empty fields), two-space indents. A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

{
  "RUN_ID": "XR-2026-09-30-01",

    "2026-10-07",

    "… 21 more dates (the run's grid dates, in order)"

    "PRIMARY",
    "PRIMARY",
    "LOOKBACK",
    "… 21 more strings"
  ],

    -1,

    "… 21 more numbers"
  ],

    "1W",

    "… 21 more strings"
  ],
  "LOOKBACK_DAYS": 10,
  "VALUE_BASIS": "FUTURE",

## XPATH: Exposure path (a trade's MtM on every path at a grid date) (`exposure-path`)

One trade's mark to market on every path of a simulation run at one grid date, in USD (the vector column MTM); the grain every exposure is netted, collateralised and counted from (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 15.3).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [exposure-path.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/exposure-path.contract.yaml) · version 1.1 |
| Class | input |
| Status | active |
| Source | the upstream exposure simulator (test data: tools/packgen/ccr/make_ccr_data.py) |
| Grain | One row per trade, grid date and run per business date, keyed by PATH_ROW_ID (<run>~<trade>~<grid index>); sparse by maturity. |
| Key | `PATH_ROW_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^XR-[^~]+~.+~[0-9]+$` |
| Dated by | `BUSINESS_DATE` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be agreed with the simulator's owner (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md open question 1); a bank's run often lands 04:00-07:00) |
| Binding hint | lake table `risk.exposure-path`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `TRADE_ID`, `NETTING_SET`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `DIVISION`, `DESK`, `TT_BOOK`, `LIMIT_LETTER`, `ASSET_CLASS`, `PRODUCT`, `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `NOTIONAL`, `GRID_INDEX`, `GRID_DATE`, `RUN_ID`, `BATCH_ID`, `STATUS` |
| Vectors | `MTM` |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/exposure-path |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PATH_ROW_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `XR-2026-09-30-01~CLY-3000280~0` (pattern `^XR-[^~]+~.+~[0-9]+$`) |  |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date | required |  | The close of business the run starts from (t0); the lake's partition. | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `RUN_ID` | id | required |  | The simulation run the row belongs to: a RUN_ID of the simulation-run kind (XR-<date>-<nn>), the same on every row of the run. | `XR-2026-09-30-01` (pattern `^XR-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]+$`) | `simulation-run` |
| `TRADE_ID` | id | required |  | The trade valued on the paths: a TRADE_ID of the trading pack's trade kind (ENDUR digits, CLY-…, MX-…), as text. | `CLY-3000280` (pattern `^((MX\|CLY)-)?\d+$`) | `trade` |
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | text | required |  | The trade's booking system: ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX. | `CALYPSO`, `ENDUR`, `ICI`, `MUREX`, `SWAPONE`, `WSS` |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | id | required |  | The netting set the trade belongs to (its membership wins when they differ). | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) | `netting-set` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | The trade's counterparty, denormalised from its netting set: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | id | required |  | The bank's legal entity that booked the trade: an ENTITY_ID of the core pack's legal-entity kind (LE-…). | `LE-FRA` (pattern `^LE-`) | `legal-entity` |
| `DIVISION` | text | optional |  | The division of the trade's desk (DIV-…): the top level column of the hierarchy MGMT (DIVISION > DESK > TT_BOOK, VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.14), as the trade's VaR records carry it. A row that leaves it empty sits under the (Blank) division. | `DIV-TREASURY` |  |
| `DESK` | id | required |  | The desk the trade is booked on: a DESK_ID of the core pack's desk kind (DESK-…). | `DESK-SFT` (pattern `^DESK-`) | `desk` |
| `TT_BOOK` | id | required |  | The book the trade is booked in: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). | `BOOK-SFT-1` (pattern `^BOOK-`) | `book` |
| `LIMIT_LETTER` | text | optional |  | The trade's limit letter, as its VaR records carry it: the level column of the hierarchy LL (LIMIT_LETTER > DESK, VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.14). Every hierarchy is built from promoted columns: a row that leaves a level column empty sits under a (Blank) node at that level, and a table that does not promote the column puts every row there, with a DRS-5211 warning. | `LL-0003` |  |
| `ASSET_CLASS` | text | required |  | The trade's asset class, denormalised from the netting set's member row (used by the asset scope). | `Commodity`, `Credit`, `Equity`, `FX`, `Fixed income`, `Inflation`, `Money market`, `Rates`, `Securities financing`, `Structured` |  |
| `PRODUCT` | text | required |  | The trade's product name, denormalised from the netting set's member row (e.g. Basis swap (float/float)). | `Tri-party repo` |  |
| `NOTIONAL` | amount | required | trade currency | The trade's notional as its netting set lists it, in the trade's currency; denormalised for people and checks. | `237000000.0` |  |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | date | required |  | The trade's maturity: after it plus 10 business days a missing grid row means the trade is worth 0. | `2027-02-15` |  |
| `GRID_INDEX` | integer | required |  | The position of the date in the run's grid. | `0` |  |
| `GRID_DATE` | date | required |  | The future date the values are for. | `2026-10-07` |  |
| `MTM` | vector | required | USD | The trade's mark to market on each simulated path at the grid date, from the bank's side. *200 values in the test data* |  |  |
| `STATUS` | text | required |  | ok, proxied (an approximate model) or failed (no values). | `ok` |  |
| `PRICER` | text | required |  | The pricer the simulator valued the trade with (testgen-factor-walk in the test data). | `testgen-factor-walk` |  |
| `BATCH_ID` | id | required |  | The run's batch: equal to the simulation-run's BATCH_ID. | `XB-2026-09-30-01` |  |

**Links:** `RUN_ID` → `simulation-run`, `TRADE_ID` → `trade`, `NETTING_SET` → `netting-set`, `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `LEGAL_ENTITY` → `legal-entity`, `DESK` → `desk`, `TT_BOOK` → `book`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `PATH_ROW_ID`, `BUSINESS_DATE`, `RUN_ID`, `TRADE_ID`, `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `NETTING_SET`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `DESK`, `TT_BOOK`, `ASSET_CLASS`, `PRODUCT`, `NOTIONAL`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `GRID_INDEX`, `GRID_DATE`, `MTM`, `STATUS`, `PRICER`, `BATCH_ID`
- unique: key `PATH_ROW_ID`; per BUSINESS_DATE
- pattern: field PATH_ROW_ID; pattern ^XR-[^~]+~.+~[0-9]+$
- link: field RUN_ID; kind simulation-run
- link: field TRADE_ID; kind trade
- enum: field SOURCE_SYSTEM; values `CALYPSO`, `ENDUR`, `ICI`, `MUREX`, `SWAPONE`, `WSS`
- link: field NETTING_SET; kind netting-set
- link: field COUNTERPARTY; kind counterparty
- link: field LEGAL_ENTITY; kind legal-entity
- link: field DESK; kind desk
- link: field TT_BOOK; kind book
- enum: field ASSET_CLASS; values `Commodity`, `Credit`, `Equity`, `FX`, `Fixed income`, `Inflation`, `Money market`, `Rates`, `Securities financing`, `Structured`
- vector-length: field MTM; same every row of one business date

**Notes**

- One trade's MtM on every path of the run at one grid date (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 15.3), the vector column MTM; sparse by maturity (no row after maturity plus 10 business days). DESK, TT_BOOK, ASSET_CLASS, PRODUCT, NOTIONAL and MATURITY_DATE are denormalised for the scopes and checks.
- 1.1: SOURCE_SYSTEM and ASSET_CLASS list every value of the test data (ENDUR trades have paths too).

**To review (6)**

- required inferred from 100% coverage in 2001 documents (1 samples and 2000 test-data documents (data/testdata/counterparty-risk/exposure-path/exposure-path.tar, data/testdata/counterparty-risk/exposure-path/exposure-path.tar)): confirm each required field is mandatory upstream, and each optional one may be empty.
- source is the pack's first listed source (its README): confirm.
- due time of each business date is not known: state it (for example, by 06:00 New York the next business day).
- enum values inferred from the data, not from a glossary: SOURCE_SYSTEM, ASSET_CLASS: confirm they are closed lists.
- number types decided by the field's name: NOTIONAL amount: confirm amount, rate or integer.
- no unit stated for the amounts NOTIONAL (docs/contracts/README.md section 7: USD unless stated): confirm the currency.

## EXP: Exposure profile of a scope (computed) (`exposure-result`)

The exposure profile (EE, ENE, EEE, PFE at 95% and 99%, EE without collateral) and the figures (CE, EPE, EEPE, peak EE and PFE, EAD under the internal model) of any counterparty scope (the scope grammar of EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 4), computed when asked by the server's exposure engine from the simulated paths, as the person asking; never stored.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [exposure-result.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/exposure-result.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | computed |
| Status | active |
| Source | computed by Drishti: the reactive connector exposure-engine (java engine com.ash.drishti.banking.exposure.ExposureResultEngine) |
| Grain | One answer per question (the scope asked for, its parameters q, collateral and run, and the business date), computed when asked. |
| Key | — |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `on request` |
| Cadence | on change (due: computed on request and again when the date's inputs load (data-version trigger)) |
| Binding hint | computed by Drishti, never bound; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `STATUS` | text | required |  | ok, or no-paths when the date's run covers none of the scope's netting sets (then NOTE says so and no figure is given). | `ok`, `no-paths` |  |
| `SCOPE` | text | required |  | The scope as asked (the id; parameters after ~, as CPTY:CP-ALDERSHOT~q=0.99). | `NSET:NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` |  |
| `CANONICAL` | text | required |  | The scope's canonical text. |  |  |
| `SCOPE_KIND` | text | optional |  | — | `netting-set`, `counterparty`, `group`, `legal-entity`, `desk`, `book`, `bank`, `trade`, `trades`, `adhoc` |  |
| `LABEL` | text | optional |  | — |  |  |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date | required |  | — |  |  |
| `RUN_ID` | id | optional |  | The simulation run the figures are computed from. |  | `simulation-run` |
| `PATHS` | integer | optional |  | — |  |  |
| `CALIBRATION` | text | optional |  | — |  |  |
| `CONFIDENCE` | rate | optional |  | q, the confidence of PEAK_PFE and PROFILE[].PFE. | `0.95` |  |
| `CE` | amount | optional | USD | Current exposure (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 18.4). |  |  |
| `EPE` | amount | optional | USD | Expected positive exposure over min(1 year, the longest maturity) (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 18.4). |  |  |
| `EEPE` | amount | optional | USD | Effective EPE (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 18.4). |  |  |
| `PEAK_EE` | amount | optional | USD | — |  |  |
| `PEAK_PFE` | amount | optional | USD | The highest PFE at CONFIDENCE over the primary dates; a scope's from its summed paths, never a sum of PFEs. |  |  |
| `PEAK_PFE_DATE` | date | optional |  | — |  |  |
| `PEAK_PFE_TENOR` | text | optional |  | — |  |  |
| `PEAK_PFE_99` | amount | optional | USD | — |  |  |
| `EAD_IMM` | amount | optional | USD | alpha x EEPE, informational (EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 18.5). |  |  |
| `HORIZON_YEARS` | rate | optional |  | T, the horizon EPE and EEPE average over. |  |  |
| `MPOR_DAYS` | integer | optional |  | The run's look-back in business days (the margin period of risk applied). |  |  |
| `COLLATERAL_MODEL` | text | optional |  | — | `lagged`, `current`, `none` |  |

|---|---|
| Contract | [cpty-mtm.contract.yaml](../../../modules/banking/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/cpty-mtm.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | computed |
| Status | active |
| Source | computed by Drishti: the derived connector ccr-derived over the kind trade-valuation |
| Grain | One record per COUNTERPARTY of the trade-valuation records, computed when asked. |
| Key | `COUNTERPARTY` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `on request` |
| Cadence | on change (due: recomputed from its source kind (connector refresh 60s)) |
| Binding hint | computed by Drishti, never bound; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | The value the trade-valuation records are grouped by ($.COUNTERPARTY) |  | `counterparty` |
| `TRADE_IDS` | id list | derived |  | The ids of the grouped trade-valuation records (at most 100000) |  |  |
| `STATUS_LIVE_COUNT` | integer | optional |  | Trade valuations of a live status naming the counterparty and a netting set |  |  |
| `MTM_CURRENCIES` | text list | optional |  | The currencies of the members' MTM: USD alone means the sums are exact |  |  |
| `VALUATION_DATES` | date list | optional |  | The members' valuation dates: the business date alone |  |  |
| `TRADES` | record list | derived |  | Every member of a live status, with its netting set and LIVE |  |  |
| `TRADE_COUNT` | integer | derived |  | Live trades: Live (DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md section 12): TRADE_STATUS NEW, VALIDATED or AMENDED and MATURITY_DATE not before the valuation date |  |  |
| `NET_MTM` | amount | derived | USD | Sum of the live trades' MTM over every netting set of the counterparty |  |  |
| `GROSS_POSITIVE_MTM` | amount | derived | USD | Sum of the live trades' positive MTM |  |  |
| `GROSS_NEGATIVE_MTM` | amount | derived | USD | Sum of the live trades' negative MTM |  |  |
| `NETTING_SETS` | record list | derived |  | Per netting set: rows {label (the set), value (its net MTM), count (its live trades)} |  |  |
| `NETTING_SET_COUNT` | integer | derived |  | The netting sets with live trades |  |  |
| `CE_UNCOLLATERALISED` | amount | derived | USD | Sum over the netting sets of max(the set's net MTM, 0): exposures never net across sets |  |  |
| `PAST_MATURITY_COUNT` | integer | derived |  | Trades of a live status past their maturity date: in no total (decision 3) |  |  |
| `SUM_CURRENCY` | text | derived |  | The currency the sums are made in: USD |  |  |
| `CURRENCY_NOTE` | text | derived |  | USD when every member's MTM is in USD; otherwise 'not converted' |  |  |

**Nested `TRADES[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADE_ID` | id | optional |  | The trade |  | `trade` |
| `NETTING_SET` | id | optional |  | Its netting set |  | `netting-set` |
| `MTM` | amount | optional | USD | Its MTM on the business date |  |  |
| `LIVE` | boolean | optional |  | Not past its maturity date |  |  |

**Links:** `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `TRADES[].TRADE_ID` → `trade`, `TRADES[].NETTING_SET` → `netting-set`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `COUNTERPARTY`
- unique: key `COUNTERPARTY`; per snapshot
- link: field COUNTERPARTY; kind counterparty
- range: field STATUS_LIVE_COUNT; min 0
- link: field TRADES[].TRADE_ID; kind trade
- link: field TRADES[].NETTING_SET; kind netting-set

**Notes**

- Derived, never stored: built from the trade valuations directly, not from nset-mtm (a derived kind cannot read another derived kind of its connector: DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md section 12, check (a)); the per-set positive parts come from group() over its rows.
- Shown on the counterparty page beside the stored NET_MTM with the difference; retires when NSET computes counterparty scopes.
